title: CSS Background Image
text:
CSS Background Image CSS background-image The background-image property specifies an image to use as the background of an element. By default, the image is repeated so it covers the entire element. Note: When using a background image, use an image that does not disturb the text. The background image can also be set for specific elements, like the

element: The CSS Background Image Property Property Description background-image Sets the background image for an element
